name: @playform/lib-dsh-bundle
description: The BUNDLE: the build tooling of the UI family (@playform/lib-dsh-bundle) - the harness client-bundle envelope (window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory(require) })) and the stylesheet compile, the two steps every UI package's build calls from its own package-local script. A package takes it as a devDependency, so a standalone install builds the same bundle the monorepo does and no plugin reaches into Maintain/. It owns no runtime, no ledger string and no loader contract - the CLASSIC build of the classical group. Usable outside the harness entirely (the PlayForm ecosystem).
